notes.text: This is a new cote's own sheet, not presumed to continue cote143. A crossed opening sentence distinguishes or determines two barred D notations, followed by a wholly cancelled six-object U diagram. The small reference after cf. remains damaged. The page's brown vertical stain is physical damage, not a deletion stroke or marginal notation.

A live triangle relates D=U(C)^sim, tilde U(C) and U(C), with pi and hat pi on its descending maps. The right object has a cancelled continuation. Separately, pi is written as a subgroup of G and H is defined by the existence of two finite-index subgroups and an isomorphism v compatible with a square. No closing set brace is written.

The square labels its upper map u, vertical maps p' and p'', and lower map v with a wave; v and the wave are both above the lower shaft. The word commutatif is beside the square. The first NB gives data in the order u,pi',pi'',v and writes u_*:pi' to pi'', with an interlinear parenthesis induit par u and a long curved guide. It then says the two subgroups have de = indice, retaining the source shorthand.

The slanting marginal note reads u est déterminé par v_*. The dark final v/star does not show an independent cancellation. The second NB contains underlined ces conditions and says that once v is known, u is known mod multiplication on the indicated side by an element written gamma followed by a membership-like sign and pi double-prime. Cancelled aux and the reduced à/colon graph remain uncertain.

The small left-margin diagram uses open cup-like inclusion curves, not arrows with shafts, and a full wave-plus-bar relation between pi' and pi''. Its lower line has low i indices and high primes. A separate calculation shows p''u=vp', a crossed attempted continuation, and the expanded composition calculation ending in an unmatched closing curved parenthesis. A final pi subset H is crossed.

The lower paragraph states that H is a group containing pi and describes H/pi, with classes on the written right-hand side, through a subset of an ensemble of germes d'isom. The source literally has H-groupes; the prefix is not regularized from mathematical expectation. The last l-apostrophe word and finis/fini remain doubtful, as does the crossed short word after d'isom. The two-bar = shorthand recurs before indice.

H_n is defined using pairs of subgroups of index n. The final line calls H_n an underlined ss-groupe and stops after et pi d'indice; no completion is supplied. Pencil footer 1 is included with unknown hand attribution.

A targeted check of the marginal calculation confirms its side of multiplication, conditional on the written covering notation: for gamma in pi'', the quotient projection satisfies p'' composed with gamma = p''. Associativity then gives p'' composed with (gamma composed with u) = (p'' composed with gamma) composed with u = p'' composed with u = v composed with p'. This verifies the displayed identity under that stated action convention. It does not establish the uniqueness claims, the group structure of H_n, or the quotient/germs identification. The unmatched final parenthesis is preserved independently of this check.

Main also checked the two annotations under the defining inclusions: each uses a shallow flat bracket with raised curved ends, without a central brace cusp. The TikZ lines preserve that shape while keeping the same labels.
